commands.name: model
commands.description: switch model/provider, fuzzy match (e.g. "sonnet", "opus"); name a provider to pin the seat

commands.name: models
commands.description: list known models: context window, compaction point, provider and what that seat costs (plan/credits/api/local); health shows live state

commands.name: clear
commands.description: wipe the conversation and start fresh

commands.name: new
commands.description: start a fresh autosaved session

commands.name: rename
commands.description: set the current session title

commands.name: goal
commands.description: set a standing objective and work it autonomously; an optional 30s/30m/2h budget paces the run; pause/resume steering, status shows state, clear removes it

commands.name: goals
commands.description: show the current goal without changing it (alias for /goal status)

commands.name: schedule
commands.description: fire a prompt later after a 30s/5m/2h delay (not a standing goal)

commands.name: adapter
commands.description: channel-worker outbox / inbox (JSONL protocol; Discord/Slack fronts later)

commands.name: review
commands.description: run one isolated read-only review pass; no edits, delegation, or workflows

commands.name: never
commands.description: standing constraints that ride every brief; bare opens a searchable picker (TTY) or lists them, rm <id-or-text> retires one (alias /constraint)

commands.name: tell
commands.description: message a running graff: <session> is a DM (only it hears, any folder); all broadcasts to every graff on this device; /sessions lists who's around

commands.name: daddy
commands.description: direct one live graff as the supervisor — control, not ambient room mail; /sessions lists who's around

commands.name: peek
commands.description: see what a live co-resident session is doing right now (its transcript tail)

commands.name: routes
commands.description: your own priced model lanes across providers — view the set and which seat wins each lane now

commands.name: plan
commands.description: toggle plan mode: read-only explore + propose; writes/edits denied

commands.name: ultracode
commands.description: toggle persistent workflow mode; bare opens an on/off picker, or /ultracode on|off

commands.name: fallback
commands.description: opt-in cross-provider fallback for this workspace (same-provider rollout stays on)

commands.name: key
commands.description: show API-key status; /key <provider> <secret> adds one live (+ Keychain)

commands.name: login
commands.description: OAuth sign-in (no key to paste); bare opens a picker (chatgpt aliases: codex, openai, oai; zai aliases: glm, z.ai; kimi sites: kimi.ai, kimi.com)

commands.name: keepcontext
commands.description: toggle keeping the conversation when /model switches wire format (default on)

commands.name: effort
commands.description: reasoning depth: low|medium|high|... (codex, deepseek, codegraff; persists)

commands.name: reasoning
commands.description: alias for /effort

commands.name: compact-at
commands.description: where automatic compaction starts, as % of the context window (default 80; persists)

commands.name: fast
commands.description: codex only: priority service tier for lower latency (toggle, persists)

commands.name: thinking
commands.description: stream reasoning live vs spinner only (toggle, persists)

commands.name: title
commands.description: name the tab from your first prompt (AI session title; toggle, persists)

commands.name: strict
commands.description: toggle "every message is a tool" mode

commands.name: yolo
commands.description: toggle bash auto-approval (skip permission prompts)

commands.name: trace
commands.description: toggle this run's JSONL event trace (and show its path)

commands.name: privacy
commands.description: control prompt-learning data egress for this session

commands.name: trajectory
commands.description: show this session's agent tree — turns + spawned subagents

commands.name: issue
commands.description: file one sanitized public tracker issue from this session

commands.name: agents
commands.description: list agent types — builtin personas + .harness/agents

commands.name: workers
commands.description: inspect this session's subagents: click/Enter for live activity and reports, Esc to return

commands.name: skills
commands.description: list SKILL.md playbooks + companion tools; add/remove enables or disables one

commands.name: plugins
commands.description: list Claude/Cursor/Grok/Codex plugin trees graff is reading in place; load names one

commands.name: hooks
commands.description: list lifecycle hooks and the built-in codedb guard

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: read-only health check: goal/todo, live jobs, model-call budget

commands.name: btw
commands.description: ask one side question about this conversation — billed, never added, rides the parent cache prefix

commands.name: compact
commands.description: compact history into a fresh context (OpenAI server-side when available)

commands.name: rewind
commands.description: list past prompts; /rewind <n> drops prompt n+after & reverts its file edits; /rewind <snapshot id> restores a sandbox filesystem instead, never the conversation

commands.name: edit
commands.description: replace prompt n, drop n+after, keep the prefix so the next turn can still hit cache

commands.name: snapshot
commands.description: capture the attached sandbox's filesystem under .graff/sessions/<session>/snapshots; attach puts this session in a Docker sandbox, list shows what it has captured, gc keeps the newest n (default 1)

commands.name: teleport
commands.description: restore a docker_image_tar snapshot onto a different CLI backend (Apple Container by default); filesystem only, never the conversation

commands.name: image
commands.description: attach an image to your next message (vision models only)

commands.name: images
commands.description: open image URLs from the last response (e.g. issue attachments) in your browser

commands.name: paste
commands.description: attach the clipboard image — macOS; also Ctrl-V (⌘V can't be captured)

commands.name: bash
commands.description: run a shell command directly

commands.name: save
commands.description: write the conversation to <name>.session.json (default: current)

commands.name: resume
commands.description: restore a saved conversation, optionally cloning it into an independent branch

commands.name: fork
commands.description: branch this conversation into a new session and continue there; the original stays saved for /resume

commands.name: sessions
commands.description: list saved sessions here and under ~/.graff/sessions

commands.name: workspace
commands.description: list git worktrees, switch, create a task workspace, or gc unused trees (free space)

commands.name: experiment
commands.description: pre-mint N child worktrees (1-16) and seat the next spawns in them; off clears the pool

commands.name: todo
commands.description: show the current task list

commands.name: jobs
commands.description: list background jobs (age, port, idle stop); keep pins a server, restart reruns one

commands.name: cost
commands.description: session token usage and cost

commands.name: usage
commands.description: session cost plus remaining Codex/xAI plan percent

commands.name: version
commands.description: show the version in this process and compare it with the latest release

commands.name: update
commands.description: check for a release and install it for the next launch (this session keeps running)

commands.name: debug
commands.description: live content-free observability HUD (turns, tokens, tools, last events)

commands.name: cache
commands.description: prompt-cache posture: prefix hash, hit rate, last bust, remaining max levers

commands.name: tools
commands.description: session tool balance: codedb-pro vs zigrep vs native usage, gate refusals, skew

commands.name: animation
commands.description: pick the thinking animation; persists to settings

commands.name: theme
commands.description: pick a color theme; /theme off resets to your terminal default; persists

commands.name: fleet
commands.description: federated DGM contribution (propose/submit/elite_pull)

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: list MCP servers/tools; /mcp add <name> <cmd> [args...] connects one live; /mcp reconnect <name> starts one again

commands.name: import-claude
commands.description: copy Claude/Cursor setup and import this project's Claude conversations for /resume

commands.name: help
commands.description: list every command
